blocks.arabic_text: مَاتَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي لَايُشْرِكُ بِاللهِ شَيْئاً دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ قُلْتُ: يَارَسُولَ اللهِ! أَفَلَا أَخْرُجُ إِلَي النَّاسِ فَأُبَشِّرُهُمْ قَالَ: دَعْهُمْ فَلْيَسْتَبِقُوا الصِّرَاطَ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Mu'adh (RA) narrates: When the Prophet ﷺ asked Hazrat Mu'adh (RA), “O Mu'adh! Did you hear any sound last night?”, he replied, “I did not hear any sound.” The Prophet ﷺ said, “An angel came to me from my Rabb and gave me the good news that whoever of my Ummah dies in a state of not associating anything at all with Allah will go to Jannah.” I asked, “Ya Rasulallah, shall I go to the people and tell them this (good) news?” The Prophet ﷺ replied, “Leave them (as they are)! Let them keep competing with one another and racing ahead on the path (of good deeds).”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ مُعَاذِبْنِ جَبَلٍ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: يَامُعَاذُ! أَتَدْرِي مَاحَقُّ اللهِ عَلَي الْعِبَادِ، وَمَا حَقُّ الْعِبَادِ عَلَي اللهِ؟ قَالَ قُلْتُ: اللهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ قَالَ: فَإِنَّ حَقَّ اللهِ عَلَي الْعِبَادِ أَنْ يَّعْبُدُوا اللهَ وَلَا يُشْرِكُوا بِهِ شَيْئاً وَحَقُّ الْعِبَادِ عَلَي اللهِ أَنْ لَايُعَذِّبَ مَنْ لَايُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (الحديث) رواه مسلم، باب الدليل علي ان من مات......، رقم:١٤٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Mu'adh (RA) narrates: When the Prophet ﷺ asked, “O Mu'adh! Do you know what duty the servants owe to Allah, and what right the servants have from Allah?”, I replied, “Allah and His Messenger know best.” He said, “The duty the servants owe to Allah is that they worship Him alone without associating anything with Allah.
